description: Flat metadata schema for individual record/trial-level metadata in human EEG experiments with visual stimuli and ERP analysis.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual trial/event/record within the dataset.

participant_id.descr: De-identified participant code; use a stable pseudonymous identifier (for example, P001).

session_id.descr: Identifier for the experimental session or visit for this participant.

recording_date.descr: Date of EEG recording in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD.

participant_age.descr: Participant age in years at time of recording.

participant_sex.descr: Participant sex as reported or recorded; use controlled values such as female, male, intersex, not_reported.

participant_gender.descr: Participant gender identity if collected; use controlled terms or not_collected.

handedness.descr: Participant handedness; for example left, right, ambidextrous, unknown.

vision_status.descr: Visual status relevant to the experiment; for example normal, corrected_to_normal, impaired, unknown.

visual_aid_used.descr: True if participant wore corrective lenses or other visual aids during the task.

task_name.descr: Name of the experimental task or paradigm.

task_description.descr: Short free-text description of the task instructions or cognitive paradigm.

stimulus_id.descr: Identifier for the presented visual stimulus.

stimulus_category.descr: Controlled label for the stimulus type or category; for example face, object, scene, letter, checkerboard.

stimulus_modality.descr: Stimulus modality; for this dataset typically visual.

stimulus_filename.descr: File name or path reference for the stimulus asset, if applicable.

stimulus_format.descr: Stimulus file format or representation, for example png, jpeg, svg, movie, text.

stimulus_onset_time_ms.descr: Onset time of the stimulus relative to recording or trial start, in milliseconds.

stimulus_offset_time_ms.descr: Offset time of the stimulus relative to recording or trial start, in milliseconds.

stimulus_size_deg.descr: Stimulus size in degrees of visual angle, if available.

stimulus_luminance_cd_m2.descr: Stimulus luminance in candela per square meter, if measured.

stimulus_contrast.descr: Stimulus contrast value; specify scale used in accompanying documentation if not unitless.

stimulus_position_x_deg.descr: Horizontal stimulus position relative to fixation, in degrees of visual angle.

stimulus_position_y_deg.descr: Vertical stimulus position relative to fixation, in degrees of visual angle.

stimulus_color_space.descr: Color space used for stimulus definition, for example RGB, HSV, CIELAB, grayscale.

stimulus_orientation_deg.descr: Stimulus orientation in degrees, if applicable.

stimulus_intensity.descr: Generic stimulus intensity or level variable, if relevant to the design.

trial_index.descr: Sequential trial number within the session, starting from 1.

block_index.descr: Sequential block number within the session, if the experiment is blocked.

condition_label.descr: Experimental condition label, for example target, non_target, oddball, baseline, control.

trial_type.descr: Trial class or event class, for example go, no_go, standard, deviant.

stimulus_representation_duration_ms.descr: If different from stimulus_duration_ms, the time the stimulus was available on screen in milliseconds.

jitter_ms.descr: Random temporal jitter applied to the timing of presentation in milliseconds.

fixation_duration_ms.descr: Fixation period duration before stimulus onset, in milliseconds.

response_required.descr: True if the participant was required to respond on this trial.

response_type.descr: Expected or collected response type; for example button_press, keypress, none.

response_key.descr: Button or key identifier used for the participant response, if applicable.

response_time_ms.descr: Reaction time from stimulus onset to response, in milliseconds.

response_accuracy.descr: True if the response was correct according to the task definition.

response_value.descr: Raw recorded response value, for example key code, button label, or numeric response.

correct_answer.descr: Correct response or target label for the trial, if applicable.

event_code.descr: Numeric or alphanumeric event marker code used in EEG acquisition or annotation.

erp_component_expected.descr: ERP component of interest for the trial or condition, for example P1, N170, P300.

eeg_system.descr: EEG acquisition system or amplifier model name.

eeg_cap_model.descr: EEG cap model or electrode array used.

reference_scheme.descr: EEG reference scheme used during acquisition or re-referencing, for example linked_mastoids, average_reference.

ground_electrode.descr: Ground electrode location or label, if used.

channel_count.descr: Total number of recorded EEG channels.

electrode_locations_standard.descr: Electrode montage standard used, for example 10-20, 10-10, custom.

impedance_kohm.descr: Average or channel-specific electrode impedance in kilo-ohms, if recorded.

filter_highpass_hz.descr: High-pass filter cutoff in hertz applied during acquisition or preprocessing.

filter_lowpass_hz.descr: Low-pass filter cutoff in hertz applied during acquisition or preprocessing.

notch_filter_hz.descr: Notch filter frequency in hertz, if applied; for example 50 or 60.

baseline_window_start_ms.descr: Start of the ERP baseline correction window relative to stimulus onset, in milliseconds.

baseline_window_end_ms.descr: End of the ERP baseline correction window relative to stimulus onset, in milliseconds.

epoch_window_start_ms.descr: Start time of the analyzed EEG epoch relative to event onset, in milliseconds.

epoch_window_end_ms.descr: End time of the analyzed EEG epoch relative to event onset, in milliseconds.

artifact_rejected.descr: True if the trial/epoch was rejected due to artifact detection or manual inspection.

artifact_reason.descr: Primary reason for artifact rejection, for example blink, muscle, movement, technical_failure.

ocular_correction_applied.descr: True if ocular artifact correction methods such as ICA or regression were applied.

preprocessing_pipeline.descr: Name or identifier of the preprocessing workflow used for the EEG data.

analysis_window_start_ms.descr: Start of the time window used for ERP measurement or statistical analysis, in milliseconds.

analysis_window_end_ms.descr: End of the time window used for ERP measurement or statistical analysis, in milliseconds.

erp_amplitude_uv.descr: Measured ERP amplitude in microvolts for the defined component/window/channel.

erp_latency_ms.descr: Latency of the ERP peak or measured response in milliseconds.

erp_peak_channel.descr: Electrode channel where the ERP component peak was measured, for example Cz, Pz, Oz.

erp_peak_polarity.descr: ERP peak polarity, for example positive, negative.

trial_outcome.descr: Outcome label for the trial, for example correct, incorrect, omitted, timeout.

notes.descr: Optional free-text notes about the specific trial, participant behavior, or acquisition anomalies.
